prompt: Build a personal knowledge wiki system following Karpathy's LLM wiki pattern. Includes: (1) A Claude Code skill for researching domains of interest that produces markdown wiki pages from internet system-of-record sources (read-only, not edited for LLM). (2) A full-stack application with React TypeScript frontend chatbot, Python FastAPI backend, LangGraph agent, and pgvector database. (3) A script to ingest skill-generated markdown into pgvector. (4) The wiki serves as a personal 360-degree knowledge base across all domains of interest.
